body_html:
Anna, originally from Fort Wayne, Indiana, began her DJing journey in 2020 and has since built an impressive four years of experience hosting corporate parties and events. Her passion for DJing stems from her love of organizing events and ensuring everything runs seamlessly. Anna thrives in her role as an emcee and host, effortlessly engaging audiences and setting the perfect tone for any occasion.

When she’s not behind the decks, Anna enjoys listening to R&B and Rap, with favorite artists including SZA, Coi Leray, GloRilla, Next, and Brandy. She finds immense joy in creating unforgettable moments, saying that the best part of being a DJ is seeing everyone having a great time and knowing she’s contributed to their happiness.

Anna’s expertise shines in corporate parties, bar and restaurant events, and outdoor gatherings. Her go-to floor fillers include classics like “Crazy in Love,” “1, 2 Step,” “Shake It Off,” and timeless hits from Mariah Carey that never fail to get the crowd moving.

Beyond her DJ career, Anna is also accomplished in sales, recruiting, and program management, bringing a unique blend of organizational skills and creative energy to every event she’s part of.
